Flight simulator gifts: choose the right platform

The recipient’s platform and existing controls determine which hardware makes sense. The Airbus grip needs a separate compatible base; ATC is a separate real-airport listening app, not a simulator integration.

The picks

Chosen for the recipient and use described, using published product information. We have not hands-on tested these products.

  1. 1. PlayStation and PC flight-sim beginners

    Thrustmaster T.Flight HOTAS 5

    A stick and detachable throttle give the beginner two physical controls in one package.

    Keep in mind
    This is not the Xbox version; individual games may need manual bindings.
    Before you choose
    Retailer lists PS5, PS4 and Windows PC. Verify the exact game and platform support.
    $109.99Listed 2026-10-21 · Unavailable when checkedView at Pilot Mall↗
  2. 2. Home sim users who prefer a yoke

    Thrustmaster TCA Sky Yoke, Xbox/PC

    Integrated throttle and trim controls reduce the number of separate units to start with.

    Keep in mind
    A yoke still needs a suitable desk edge and storage space.
    Before you choose
    Choose the Xbox Series X/S and PC variant; verify game support and mounting clearance.
    $199.99Listed 2026-10-21View at Pilot Mall↗
  3. 3. PC military-flight-sim enthusiasts

    Thrustmaster HOTAS Warthog MKII

    A separate metal stick and twin throttle suit a dedicated simulator station.

    Keep in mind
    A costly, bulky choice for someone who only flies casually.
    Before you choose
    Retailer specifies Windows 10/11 PC; check desk mounting, game support and existing rudder controls.
    $599.99Listed 2026-10-21View at Pilot Mall↗
  4. 4. PC sim users with a compatible modular base

    Thrustmaster Airbus Add-On Grip

    A left-hand Airbus-style grip is a focused upgrade for an existing setup.

    Keep in mind
    The grip alone is not a working joystick; the base is sold separately.
    Before you choose
    Windows PC and an explicitly compatible Thrustmaster modular base are required.
    $129.99Listed 2026-10-21View at Pilot Mall↗
  5. 5. Airport-radio listeners and plane spotters

    ATC — Live Air Traffic Radio

    Our app: Pilot Gift Guide is produced by the team behind ATC. This is a recommendation of our own product.

    A simulator enthusiast who enjoys radio traffic may also like exploring ATC on an iPhone. It offers live airport audio, maps, transcripts and replay as a separate listening experience. It is not a simulator add-on or a connection to a virtual ATC network; choose it for their curiosity about real airport activity.

    Live airport audio with aircraft maps, transcripts and replay in one iPhone app.

    Keep in mind
    Coverage varies by airport; a subscription is not automatically transferable as a gift.
    Before you choose
    iPhone with iOS 18 or later; check airport coverage and current plans.
    Subscription; see current plansListed 2026-10-21Explore ATC↗

How to choose

Ask for exact software versions and hardware model numbers before buying. A PC product may not suit a console setup, and similarly named control variants can differ. The best gift improves the recipient’s existing experience rather than requiring a chain of unplanned purchases.

Prices and availability can change. Check the exact model, delivered total and return terms with the seller. Our recommendations are researched editorial selections, not hands-on test results.
